review_cost.rationale: Approve-able architecture, but one real round of changes (not-found semantics, error boundary, search-state hardening) plus a nit list before I'd sign off.

findings.issue: No errorComponent/defaultErrorComponent anywhere, so any API failure thrown from app/src/lib/api.server.ts:68 surfaces as TanStack Start's generic JSON 500 body instead of an error UI.
findings.suggestion: Add a DefaultCatchBoundary errorComponent on the root route (and optionally per-route), matching the official start-basic example.

findings.issue: All detail routes return null from the loader and render NotFound in the component, and the splat route (app/src/routes/$.tsx:4) does the same, so every not-found page is served as HTTP 200.
findings.suggestion: Throw notFound() from the loaders (or return it) and let the root notFoundComponent handle it, which also yields proper 404 responses.

findings.issue: Search navigates on every keystroke with no debounce, and index.tsx:44-46 mirrors the committed search.q back into local input state, which can transiently revert typed characters while a newer navigation is in flight.
findings.suggestion: Debounce navigation by ~300 ms (explicitly allowed by the spec) and/or derive the input value solely from useSearch instead of a mirrored useState.

findings.issue: Module-level memo cache never evicts expired entries and has no size cap; it is bounded by dataset size but can grow to tens of MB per server process.
findings.suggestion: Delete expired keys on access or cap the Map (e.g. simple LRU) and note the caching policy in a comment.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled requestAnimationFrame hash-scroll effect duplicates the router's built-in hashScrollIntoView, which defaults to true and runs after location commit.
findings.suggestion: Delete the effect and rely on scrollRestoration + hashScrollIntoView; if a special case remains, pass hashScrollIntoView options to navigate.

findings.issue: Duplicated construction of the name→type map (also built by getTypeMap at line 139), and the ability-page card loop (507-523) near-duplicates cardsFromPokemonRefs (236-257).
findings.suggestion: Reuse getTypeMap in loadTypePage and extend cardsFromPokemonRefs with an optional per-pokemon flag callback so the two loops can't drift.

findings.issue: Dead view-model weight: `found: true` discriminants are never checked (components test null instead), and PokemonPageData.name/sprite are computed but unused.
findings.suggestion: Drop `found`, `name` and the unused `sprite` field, or actually use the discriminant in a type guard.

findings.issue: spriteForId synthesizes sprite URLs from the species ID rather than using the API-provided sprite URLs, and the whole app contains zero comments explaining such non-obvious choices.
findings.suggestion: Add a short comment citing the spec's documented sprite-URL pattern and the id>10000 alternate-form exclusion.

findings.issue: defaultPreloadStaleTime: 0 makes intent preloading immediately stale, so hover-preloaded data is always refetched on click.
findings.suggestion: Set a modest staleTime (e.g. 30_000) or drop the option and rely on the default.

findings.issue: Dead config: the `#/*` import map and both tsconfig path aliases are unused (all imports are relative), and no .gitignore covers app/dist and app/.tanstack build artifacts.
findings.suggestion: Remove the unused aliases (or actually use one consistently) and add app/.gitignore entries for dist/, .tanstack/ and node_modules/.

summary: This is a well-built TanStack Start app: current-stable APIs throughout, a clean routes → server-fn → server-only loader → typed view-model boundary, and tidy token-driven CSS. The main gaps a reviewer would flag are robustness and semantics rather than structure: no error boundary in front of a flaky API dependency, not-found pages rendered at HTTP 200 instead of using the framework's notFound(), and an undebounced per-keystroke search navigation with a mirrored-state race. I'd merge after one focused round of fixes and a nit pass.
